items: ¼ cup pistachio, walnuts or cashews, roughly chopped
2 sprigs each of mint and parsley, leaves picked and chopped
Zest and juice of ½ lemon

steps: Heat oil in a large pan and add half of the diced onion, and cook to soften.
Add spices followed by mince, and fry for 2-3 minutes until browned.
Add tomato paste and stock and cook for 8-10 minutes until most of the liquid has evaporated, then season with salt and pepper.
In a bowl, combine tahini, Greek yoghurt, lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
In a separate bowl, mix the salad mixture ingredients with a splash of EVOO.
Fold pistachios and feta through the mince and spread a spoonful of each sauce on the wraps.
Fold the sides of the wrap in, brush in a little oil and place in a pan seam-side-down.
Cook for half a minute on each side until golden and crisp - cut in half diagonally and serve with lemon.

notes: You can customise many of the components, particularly the salad mixture components.
